author: CrazyHarv
body:
Username = CrazyHarv

Reason = Ban Evasion

Why:
On 12/31/2015 I was wrongly banned permanently due MOD OscarIsNotAmused as he was convinced that my account was an alternate to the recently temporarily banned CrazyBlader (my friends account as he was not being a good sport and spamming) as during the time he was banned he was next to me (in real life) and used my account/computer to deliver messages to Oscar and minecraft friends (who were on at the time).

Evidence:
If u can message me privately, I can send you a link that will prove we are separate people.

Thank You.

title: False Ban for Ban Evasion

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello CrazyHarv,

Regardless of whether he was beside you or not, after going through your chat logs it is very clear that he did use this account to communicate to other users. By doing this he is ban evading. I believe you are two different people but he did type messages to people using this account, none the less, ban evading. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
